annotations.title: Rank all countries by an indicator (World Bank)

description: Rank all countries by an indicator (World Bank) — Ranks every country by a World Bank indicator (GDP, GDP per capita, growth, population, inflation, unemployment, life expectancy, debt, internet use, and more, or any indicator code) using each country latest value, with median, highest and lowest, optional region or income filter, and the rank of a focus country. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

country.description: optional ISO code or name to locate, e.g. US

indicator.description: gdp | gdp-per-capita | gdp-growth | population | inflation | unemployment | life-expectancy | govt-debt | internet | fertility ... or a World Bank code like NY.GDP.MKTP.CD

name: econ_country_rank
